knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Permanent eyeliner is skin penetration and is outside the course. A signed consent form does not change the scope.
A patch test is done before use for new products or higher-risk clients, and the result is recorded.
A patch test gives information for that client. It is not a guarantee and does not replace the intake.

practicalCriteria: Assessor presents a request for a permanent service and observes the candidate decline, record it and offer an approved alternative
Assessor checks that the candidate completes the allergy intake and records a patch-test decision for a new product
Assessor checks that consent covers the products and any photos before work starts
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Record of the declined request, with reason and date
stopWorkCriteria: The candidate offers or begins a permanent or skin-penetrating service
The candidate applies a new product without a patch-test decision
The client reports a reaction and the candidate continues
